notes: FORM CHARACTERISATION (2026 stock, sixth specimen) — variant modern_boxAF, footer 'v. 12.23' on every page, masthead 'Aaron Davidson, Clerk'. Four pages, summary LAST, each classified from its own printed header: p1 cover, p2 'Schedule A - Itemized Contributions Received', p3 'Schedule B - Itemized Expenditures Made', p4 'Summary Page'. NO CHECKLIST DECOY is bound in this document. Schedule A's third column is headed 'City and Zip Code' (the Bowles/Herrin/Forbush blank, not the Voeks 'Address and Zip Code' one — four filings now on each side of that split, all under the same v. 12.23 footer). Schedule B keeps the real Purpose column; both schedules are boxed 15-row grids printing their own two footers; the Summary Page prints A, B/C, D/E, F and an UNLETTERED close box. Report type '30 Days after withdrawal or elimination' is ticked, the amendment question is ticked 'No', and the report is dated 04.29.2026 throughout. WHOLLY HANDWRITTEN on the printed form in a large clear hand, in contrast with the typed 2026 filings in this chunk. CLERK RECEIPT STAMP — independent date evidence, worth citing: the cover carries a two-colour 'Received / APR 29 2026 / In Person / Utah County Clerk' stamp, so the county's own receipt date agrees to the day with every date the filer wrote. FOLIATION IS ERRATIC AND LOCATES NOTHING: the Page box reads '2' on the Schedule A sheet, '1' on the Schedule B sheet and '2' again on the Summary Page, with no 'of N' component anywhere — the filer appears to have restarted numbering partway through. This is one more instance of the wave's standing finding that a page ordinal never locates a page; every page here was classified from its own printed header. FILER ARITHMETIC RETAINED VERBATIM, NOT ADJUDICATED: Box A prints $3,600 — the same figure as Box B — and Box F ('Box A + Box B') prints $3,600 rather than 7,200, so the candidate's one 3,600.00 payment is booked both as an opening balance and as a period contribution. The close box holds a SLASHED ZERO, transcribed as 0 under the repo-wide zero-glyph ruling. None of this touches an itemized row, and both sides gate on Box B / Box D, each corroborated twice by the schedules' own footers. Evans'; the page face governs and the divergence is recorded. REDACTION — A SOURCE PROPERTY WORTH FLAGGING, and the second instance in this chunk: this file is named '_Redacted' and the county blacked out ONLY the signature block. The candidate's full home street address, his phone number and his email are published IN THE CLEAR in the cover's Address row, and neither schedule carries any redaction. Nothing from that row is carried into this record.
